project_type: Flask web app deployed on Railway with Gunicorn
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'pip install -r requirements.txt' to install deps. 2. Run 'python -c "import app"' to verify syntax. 3. Verify /api/ai-chat endpoint logic by reading code.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. GEMINI_API_KEY env var needed at runtime but not available in sandbox for live testing. Validate via syntax/import checks.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT touch TikTok downloader code. Do NOT hardcode API keys. Do NOT modify downloader endpoints.
key_patterns: Flask app with routes in app.py. Frontend JS in /static/js/. CSS in /static/css/. Single-page app with views toggled via JS. Gemini model configured at module level using google-generativeai SDK.
directory_structure: app.py = main Flask backend. static/js/makima-ai.js = MAKIMA AI frontend logic. static/css/makima-ai.css = MAKIMA AI styles. templates/index.html = single HTML template.
